# **Meet the Venture Guides Team**

#### [Our Team](https://www.ventureguides.com/our-team\#our-team) \| [Our Strategic Advisors](https://www.ventureguides.com/our-team\#our-strategic-advisors) \| [Careers](https://www.ventureguides.com/careers)

The Venture Guides team includes Forbes’ Midas List of the World’s Best Venture Investors, former operators, and builders whose careers have included roles as CEOs, CFOs, CMOs, CHROs, and GCs. We have learned from our hands-on, start-up experience in building, operating, and leading businesses which helps us guide our companies to success.
